mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in UNRATE above 0.05 percentage points triggers a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 trading days, reflecting investor concerns about labor market tightness.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns do not decline significantly (p > 0.05) when UNRATE crosses above 0.05pp threshold.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in both GDPC1 (demand) and INDPRO (supply) signals robust economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and INDPRO increase in the same month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not positive when both GDPC1 and INDPRO increase simultaneously (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a sustained decline in FEDFUNDS rates predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as lower borrowing costs boost equity valuations.
failure_condition: In monetary tightening cycles, 20-day forward returns are not higher than baseline (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in INDPRO (supply) index signals robust production growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as market confidence strengthens.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not positive when INDPRO increases (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly surge in GDPC1 (demand) above 12,000 billion chained 2017 dollars triggers a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 trading days, reflecting market overreaction to strong demand.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns do not decline significantly (p > 0.05) when GDPC1 crosses above 12,000.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in PAYEMS (employment) and decrease in UNRATE (unemployment) signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases in the same month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not positive when both PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, sustained low UNRATE (below 4%) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as market anticipates prolonged growth.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions, 60-day forward returns are not positive when UNRATE remains below 4% (p > 0.05).
